config.sample_end_rule: fixed common fitting window 2009-2024; identical to runs 1 and 2
config.rho_selection: sigma=0.5, rho=1/sigma=2; model-compatible capital-labor complementarity analogy, not a direct V6 skill-input estimate; see ../../shared/references/rho_selection.md
config.money_unit: trillion 2017 USD, all nominal values divided by calendar-year mean GDPDEF/100
config.labor_unit: H normalized to one at every date; L_t = observed L_t/H_t (unskilled workers per skilled worker)
config.regime: all sample dates treated as u as a maintained hypothesis, not an observed regime classification
config.scope: US annual conditional production block with H normalized to one and L equal to the observed annual L/H ratio; no RoW, finance, regime-b or GE calibration
config.run_title: Run 3: H normalized to one, L = observed L/H
config.labor_mean_rule: no averaging: H_t=1 and L_t=L_t^obs/H_t^obs for each of the 16 annual fitting rows, before wage bridging

sample.averaging_rule: no averaging: H_t=1 and L_t=L_t^obs/H_t^obs for each of the 16 annual fitting rows, before wage bridging

status.scope: US annual conditional production block with H normalized to one and L equal to the observed annual L/H ratio; no RoW, finance, regime-b or GE calibration
